lesson_title: Can You Un-Bake a Bread Roll?
hook_text: You can melt jelly and set it again. But try un-baking a bread roll.
clip_script: Technology Day in Upington. Powder becomes a handprint plaque. Loose cement, sand and stones become a stepping stone you can stand on. Squishy clay becomes a hard pot after the kiln. Sticky dough becomes a crusty bread roll. Now the tests: scratch, load, drip. Concrete wins the strength test. Plaster is hard but cracks. And none of them can go back. New materials, new properties, no going back.
visual_style: Whiteboard before-and-after table filling in row by row, then a big arrow that cannot be reversed.
mood: Playful and surprising, like a science cooking show.
pacing: Four quick transformations, three quick tests, one big question.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a before-and-after table for something you cook.
